q: Does FSC paper let a Sivakasi carton printer claim lower carbon?
title: Sivakasi cartons: FSC is not a carbon claim
short: No. FSC certifies where the wood fibre came from and how the forest is managed. It does not state a carbon figure, so a carbon claim still needs the board's emissions per tonne from the mill and your own press energy.
audience: Carton and packaging printers in the Sivakasi cluster of Tamil Nadu

p: That the board is FSC certified, with the certificate number.
A carbon figure only if you calculated it from the mill's data and your own energy.
Whether the carbon figure names its source and period. A certificate logo alone does not answer that.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
